sentence: One two-stage survey models AI capabilities as inputs to the firm's adaptive response to market change and finds that this response lifts firm performance and innovation
passage: [Sullivan & Fosso Wamba (2024), p. 1] "This research examines how AI-powered capabilities can bring value to organizations by enhancing their Adaptive Response to Market Changes (ARMC)." / "we find that ARMC positively influences firm performance and innovation."

gemini.note: The passage supports the claims about AI capabilities, adaptive response, and firm performance, but it does not mention that the research used a two-stage survey methodology.
